name: Lahori Chargha
description: A Lahore-style whole chicken marinated with bold spices and lemon, steamed until tender and finished until richly browned.
method: Make deep cuts in the chicken so the marinade reaches the meat.
Mix yogurt, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, spices, gram flour and salt.
Rub the marinade all over the chicken and refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Steam the chicken until fully cooked and tender.
Finish by shallow frying, deep frying or roasting until the outside is richly browned.
Serve hot with chaat masala, lemon wedges and chutney.
